name: Fiadh Colter
source:
The ward from the Colters. Fiadh and [url=/c146929]Bael[/url] have been best friends since childhood and will likely have to be approached as a unit.

[url=/c146901]Cerys[/url] says Fiadh used to be a bit of a wild child, but is more formal and polite these days.
